summary: Streaming (SSE) stalls mid-response for some requests on hosted API
description:
Issue summary:
Customer reports that streaming responses intermittently stop mid-generation. Connection stays open, but no more tokens arrive. Non-streaming responses for the same prompt complete successfully.

Impact:
Customer-facing chat feature appears to hang; end users refresh/retry.

Environment:
Hosted Redwood API, us-east, streaming=true (SSE).

Steps to reproduce (from customer):
1) Send chat completion with streaming enabled
2) Receive tokens for ~10-20 seconds
3) Stream stops progressing (no error, no DONE)

Customer evidence:
- Request IDs shared via email (see comments)
- Occurs 2-5% of requests under load

Initial hypothesis:
SSE connection not closing due to upstream worker timeout / stalled generator loop.
comments: Avery Johnson (Support): Customer says this started last week; they see it mostly on longer outputs. Asking for request IDs + timestamps.
Customer (via Support): Repro is intermittent. Sample request_id=rwreq_9b2f... at 2025-10-27T21:14Z. Stream stops after token ~1800.
Elliot Price (SRE): Checked api-gateway logs for rwreq_9b2f...: gateway kept the connection open; upstream worker stopped sending chunks ~35s after start. No 5xx. Looks like worker-side stall.
Dev Patel (Eng Runtime): Found a code path where generator loop can block if downstream backpressure + heartbeat not emitted. Patch adds periodic keepalive chunk and ensures flush in error path.
Elliot Price (SRE): Rolled patch to 10% canary in us-east. Monitoring: no new stalled streams in canary cohort over 6h.
Avery Johnson (Support): Confirmed with customer on 2025-11-02: they have not seen further streaming hangs. Marking resolved; keeping an eye on rate.
